scope: Public preview only. Training content, real videos, tutor responses and assessments require verified paid access.
weeks: Apply AI to marketing and business

navigation_policy.previous: accessible for any lesson previously opened
navigation_policy.progression: server-verified completion required for advancing where configured
navigation_policy.access: server-verified subscription required for all private lesson materials

lessons.title: Start with a useful goal
lessons.objective: Practise and demonstrate: start with a useful goal.
lessons.exercise: Choose an everyday or business task to improve with AI. Write a two-sentence goal, define success and save a starting example.
lessons.tutor_guidance: Ask one clarifying question, flag sensitive data and help establish observable criteria.
lessons.check: Is the goal specific and the result observable?
lessons.tools: Nexversion AI tutor and supplied examples

lessons.title: Write a clear prompt
lessons.objective: Practise and demonstrate: write a clear prompt.
lessons.exercise: Turn the goal into a prompt with context, constraints and output format. Generate and save one short response.
lessons.tutor_guidance: Point out the most important missing instruction and guide one precise revision.
lessons.check: Does the prompt contain goal, context, constraints and output format?
lessons.tools: Nexversion AI tutor and supplied examples

lessons.title: Control the output
lessons.objective: Practise and demonstrate: control the output.
lessons.exercise: Ask for the same information as a paragraph and checklist; compare and save a reusable template.
lessons.tutor_guidance: Check format and length against the request and ask which version serves the purpose.
lessons.check: Does the saved output use the requested format?
lessons.tools: Nexversion AI tutor and supplied examples

lessons.title: Give context safely
lessons.objective: Practise and demonstrate: give context safely.
lessons.exercise: Write a five-point safe brief covering audience, purpose, facts, limits and missing information.
lessons.tutor_guidance: Separate necessary context from personal details and identify missing facts.
lessons.check: Have unnecessary personal details been removed?
lessons.tools: Nexversion AI tutor and supplied examples

lessons.title: Check facts and uncertainty
lessons.objective: Practise and demonstrate: check facts and uncertainty.
lessons.exercise: Compare three AI-generated claims with supplied source evidence. Label each supported, contradicted or unverified.
lessons.tutor_guidance: Ground every correction in supplied evidence and explain remaining uncertainty.
lessons.check: Are unsupported claims marked rather than presented as facts?
lessons.tools: Nexversion AI tutor and supplied examples

lessons.title: Improve through revision
lessons.objective: Practise and demonstrate: improve through revision.
lessons.exercise: Improve a short response for accuracy, relevance and clarity. Save original and revised versions.
lessons.tutor_guidance: Turn vague criticism into one actionable edit and compare the two versions.
lessons.check: Does the revision address a clear, measurable weakness?
lessons.tools: Nexversion AI tutor and supplied examples

lessons.title: Complete the foundations challenge
lessons.objective: Practise and demonstrate: complete the foundations challenge.
lessons.exercise: Use a new brief to write a prompt, produce a response, verify one claim and save the result.
lessons.tutor_guidance: Assess clarity, context, evidence and privacy; request one improvement.
lessons.check: Does the final prompt and response meet clarity and evidence criteria?
lessons.tools: Nexversion AI tutor and supplied examples

lessons.title: Write better emails
lessons.objective: Practise and demonstrate: write better emails.
lessons.exercise: Draft an email of at most 100 words from supplied facts. Include purpose, tone and next step.
lessons.tutor_guidance: Flag invented promises, unclear requests and unnecessary detail; strengthen the next step.
lessons.check: Does the email have a clear, factual next step?
lessons.tools: Nexversion AI tutor and supplied examples

lessons.title: Summarise without distorting
lessons.objective: Practise and demonstrate: summarise without distorting.
lessons.exercise: Summarise supplied text into three key points and two actions without inventing facts.
lessons.tutor_guidance: Highlight omissions or unsupported claims by comparing the summary with the source.
lessons.check: Are source qualifications preserved without added claims?
lessons.tools: Nexversion AI tutor and supplied examples

lessons.title: Build a realistic daily plan
lessons.objective: Practise and demonstrate: build a realistic daily plan.
lessons.exercise: Prioritise six supplied tasks within a fixed time budget and build a realistic schedule.
lessons.tutor_guidance: Check the time budget and challenge conflicting priorities.
lessons.check: Does the schedule fit the available time?
lessons.tools: Nexversion AI tutor and supplied examples

lessons.title: Research with better questions
lessons.objective: Practise and demonstrate: research with better questions.
lessons.exercise: Create a research question and three supporting questions; map evidence and unknowns.
lessons.tutor_guidance: Distinguish evidence from opinion and identify unresolved questions.
lessons.check: Are unanswered questions distinguished from evidence?
lessons.tools: Nexversion AI tutor and supplied examples

lessons.title: Understand a small data table
lessons.objective: Practise and demonstrate: understand a small data table.
lessons.exercise: Read a fictional eight-row data table, calculate a total or percentage and explain two patterns.
lessons.tutor_guidance: Verify calculations and ask for the working used.
lessons.check: Are calculations correct and assumptions stated?
lessons.tools: Nexversion AI tutor and supplied examples

lessons.title: Turn notes into actions
lessons.objective: Practise and demonstrate: turn notes into actions.
lessons.exercise: Convert a supplied meeting transcript into tasks, owners and deadlines; label missing information.
lessons.tutor_guidance: Identify unsupported commitments or owners in the source notes.
lessons.check: Are owners and deadlines sourced rather than invented?
lessons.tools: Nexversion AI tutor and supplied examples

lessons.title: Create your work update
lessons.objective: Practise and demonstrate: create your work update.
lessons.exercise: Combine a plan, meeting actions and a finding into a 150-word work update.
lessons.tutor_guidance: Check consistency and remove misleading confidence.
lessons.check: Does the work update reflect the saved source material?
lessons.tools: Nexversion AI tutor and supplied examples

lessons.title: Understand your audience
lessons.objective: Practise and demonstrate: understand your audience.
lessons.exercise: Create an audience profile with three needs and two research questions; label assumptions.
lessons.tutor_guidance: Challenge unsupported stereotypes and missing audience evidence.
lessons.check: Are assumptions labelled and stereotypes avoided?
lessons.tools: Nexversion AI tutor and supplied examples

lessons.title: Explain your value
lessons.objective: Practise and demonstrate: explain your value.
lessons.exercise: Write a two-sentence value proposition grounded in a supplied project brief.
lessons.tutor_guidance: Identify exaggerated claims or invented proof and request a clearer benefit.
lessons.check: Does the value proposition avoid claims without evidence?
lessons.tools: Nexversion AI tutor and supplied examples

lessons.title: Create useful marketing copy
lessons.objective: Practise and demonstrate: create useful marketing copy.
lessons.exercise: Draft three consistent short marketing messages; choose and justify the strongest.
lessons.tutor_guidance: Check relevance, clarity and the call to action without changing factual claims.
lessons.check: Do all variants preserve the supplied offer and claims?
lessons.tools: Nexversion AI tutor and supplied examples

lessons.title: Plan three pieces of content
lessons.objective: Practise and demonstrate: plan three pieces of content.
lessons.exercise: Build a three-item content plan with purpose, headline and call to action.
lessons.tutor_guidance: Spot repetition and strengthen audience relevance across the three items.
lessons.check: Is each content item tied to an audience need?
lessons.tools: Nexversion AI tutor and supplied examples

lessons.title: Write a creative brief
lessons.objective: Practise and demonstrate: write a creative brief.
lessons.exercise: Write a creative visual brief covering audience, message, composition and colour.
lessons.tutor_guidance: Review accessibility, readability, composition and misleading visual claims.
lessons.check: Is the creative brief readable and truthful?
lessons.tools: Nexversion AI tutor and supplied examples

lessons.title: Respond to customers responsibly
lessons.objective: Practise and demonstrate: respond to customers responsibly.
lessons.exercise: Draft a routine and an escalation customer reply using a supplied service policy.
lessons.tutor_guidance: Check policy accuracy, tone, privacy and escalation logic.
lessons.check: Is the escalation decision consistent with the policy?
lessons.tools: Nexversion AI tutor and supplied examples

lessons.title: Assemble a mini campaign
lessons.objective: Practise and demonstrate: assemble a mini campaign.
lessons.exercise: Combine the audience profile, proposition, copy and content plan into a mini campaign.
lessons.tutor_guidance: Check campaign alignment, stated evidence and measurable objectives.
lessons.check: Does the campaign have one measurable objective?
lessons.tools: Nexversion AI tutor and supplied examples

lessons.title: Map a repeatable workflow
lessons.objective: Practise and demonstrate: map a repeatable workflow.
lessons.exercise: Map a repeated task in five steps, identifying inputs, AI assistance, review and output.
lessons.tutor_guidance: Identify weak handoffs or missing human approval points.
lessons.check: Is a human review point included where necessary?
lessons.tools: Nexversion AI tutor and supplied examples

lessons.title: Build a reusable prompt
lessons.objective: Practise and demonstrate: build a reusable prompt.
lessons.exercise: Create and test a reusable workflow prompt with clearly labelled placeholders.
lessons.tutor_guidance: Check placeholders, data assumptions, output format and verification safeguards.
lessons.check: Are variable inputs and acceptance checks explicit?
lessons.tools: Nexversion AI tutor and supplied examples

lessons.title: Add decision rules
lessons.objective: Practise and demonstrate: add decision rules.
lessons.exercise: Define decision rules for complete, missing and human-reviewed requests. Apply to three cases.
lessons.tutor_guidance: Test the rules for guessing and unsafe autonomy.
lessons.check: Are incomplete cases handled without guessing?
lessons.tools: Nexversion AI tutor and supplied examples

lessons.title: Document the process
lessons.objective: Practise and demonstrate: document the process.
lessons.exercise: Write a short operating guide covering input, prompt, checks, approvals and secure saving.
lessons.tutor_guidance: Read instructions as a first-time user and clarify the weakest step.
lessons.check: Can another person follow the process safely?
lessons.tools: Nexversion AI tutor and supplied examples

lessons.title: Test for reliability
lessons.objective: Practise and demonstrate: test for reliability.
lessons.exercise: Test a normal, incomplete and misleading-instruction case; record and fix one weakness.
lessons.tutor_guidance: Explain the failure mode and improve the offending prompt or rule.
lessons.check: Did the three test cases reveal and resolve a weakness?
lessons.tools: Nexversion AI tutor and supplied examples

lessons.title: Prepare your portfolio
lessons.objective: Practise and demonstrate: prepare your portfolio.
lessons.exercise: Select five saved outputs, improve the weakest and complete accuracy and privacy checks.
lessons.tutor_guidance: Check missing evidence, privacy risks and portfolio coherence.
lessons.check: Are all five portfolio outputs accurate and privacy-safe?
lessons.tools: Nexversion AI tutor and supplied examples

lessons.title: Complete your AI action pack
lessons.objective: Practise and demonstrate: complete your ai action pack.
lessons.exercise: Combine five outputs into an AI action pack with goals, safeguards, next steps and reflection.
lessons.tutor_guidance: Apply a transparent rubric to the action pack and guide a final revision.
lessons.check: Does the final action pack explain results, limits and next steps?
lessons.deliverable: Final AI action pack and reflection
lessons.tools: Nexversion AI tutor and supplied examples
